publication.title: Single-cell analysis of human primary prostate cancer reveals the heterogeneity of tumor-associated epithelial cell states

repository.used_component: The repository-linked annotated epithelial Seurat output plus Seqwell_Combined_E.R normalization, explicit paired-donor mapping and fixed displayed marker lists.
repository.execution_scope: Original R scripts were inspected, not executed. The supplied Python extractor independently parses the deposited object and recomputes log-normalized expression, verifying it against the deposited RNA data slot.

archive.reuse_note: The archive is not redistributed here. No separate license file is supplied inside the archive; this demo publishes derived summaries with source attribution.

deposited_object.sample_group_note: These are author orig.ident groups, not 15 independent physical specimens. Biopsy replicates have already been merged within their three donor identifiers.

derived_json.value_precision: Unrounded float64-derived values; display rounding is not used by review rules.

transformations: Verify deposited object SHA256; parse only metadata, author identities and RNA assay components, without evaluating stored R commands.
Verify nonnegative integer counts, exact cell order, identity-label agreement and positive all-feature per-cell totals.
Select the fixed 20-gene panel before inspecting results; IL8 is present, CXCL8 is absent, so no alias replacement or summation occurs.
Compute natural log(1 + 10000 * gene count / all 21877 deposited-feature counts per cell); compare every selected gene/cell value with the deposited RNA data slot.
Summarize mean expression and detection fraction by original sample group, donor, collection tissue and author cell state.
Restrict each comparison to one collection context; require coverage in both states for the same donor. Compare equal-donor and pooled-cell estimates using exactly the same eligible cells.
Compute descriptive leave-one-donor-out means and a transparent positive-marker review rule; no p-values, confidence intervals, prediction accuracy or causal claims.
limits: Processed public data and original author state assignments are retained; no alignment, fresh QC, clustering, tumor diagnosis or longitudinal lineage reconstruction was performed.
The fixed marker panel is biologically preselected and cannot establish transcriptome-wide target discovery or therapeutic efficacy.
Cells are not independent patient replicates. Small donor counts, tissue composition, annotation uncertainty and data-generation choices limit generalization.
Leave-one-donor-out stability is a within-cohort sensitivity analysis, not held-out validation or a population confidence interval.
A second independently collected cohort and orthogonal annotation/experimental confirmation are required before relying on a marker for a new biological or clinical conclusion.
